name: Exterior Fence Surface Preparation
intent: Moisture test, seasoning verify, mill glaze sand, pressure wash, mildew treatment.
doctrine: Fence prep. MC < 15% hard stop. Seasoning 30+ days for new pressure-treated. Mill glaze sand 65 SF/hr. Pressure wash at 400 SF/hr. Fence is BOTH sides (rates per side SF, total area = 2x fence footprint).
